sop_markdown:
# Insert Item into Vase

Place an item into the vase on your right, ensuring proper alignment and preventing spills.

## Before you start
- Have the vase on your right ready.
- Hold the item in your right hand.

## 1. **Insert First Item**
Push the item held in the right hand into the vase on your right.  
**Why:** I check the left parts before placing them in the tray. (expert)

## 2. **Insert Second Item**
Push the item held in the right hand into the vase on your right.  
**Why:** Prevent misalignment and ensure the item fits properly. (inferred)

## Check your work
- Verify that both items are centered in the vase.  
- Ensure no spills or misalignments.

quiz.q: Why does the expert check the left parts before placing them in the tray?
choices: To ensure the parts are clean
quiz.explain: Checking ensures parts are correctly oriented before insertion.

quiz.q: What is the main reason for preventing misalignment when inserting the second item?
choices: To ensure the item fits properly
quiz.explain: Proper alignment guarantees the item fits without forcing.

quiz.q: Why is it important to hold the item steady during insertion?
quiz.explain: A steady hand prevents the item from falling.

safety: Keep hands clear of sharp edges.
Ensure the vase is stable before inserting items.
Do not force items; adjust alignment first.
